📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-08-14-nonprod-apps-redis-crossslot-cacheflush`
This is occurrence #3 (first-ever #triage-results notify on this entry — prior 2 occurrences were below the actionable threshold).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Confirm shape via monitor 227940275, then run trace.redis.command.errors by {service} for the fire window — if nonprod/apps (not runtime-core-api), this entry's family applies, not the two runtime-core-api-scoped siblings. ES-confirm the CROSSSLOT signature ("Error clearing cache items async..." / StackExchange.Redis.RedisServerException "attempted to access keys that don't hash to the same slot"). Root cause: RedisCacheExtended.FlushEndpointWithLuaAsync issues a multi-key Lua DEL against keys that don't share a hash slot under Redis Cluster. Fix direction: hash-tag the flush key set, or replace the Lua multi-key DEL with a per-key delete loop.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_jira not filed
